Decision: INCLUDE. The paper runs a paired RAG ON/OFF experiment on text-based LLM responses, so it evaluates a RAG method directly.

The system also uses speech, object detection and XR, so E9 (multimodal-only RAG) needs a check. The retrieval and generation are text-based, with speech transcribed to text and curated cultural heritage knowledge as the corpus. The multimodal elements are inputs and interface, not multimodal retrieval. Text-only RAG is in scope, so E9 does not apply.
